Went to Pakistan 10 years ago  with my Pakistani - American wife and son.   
Yes, there is a lot of poverty, and pollution but as a whole most pakis are hard working, dedicated to family. Guests are treated very hospitably. Most families are made up of large  extended groups. My wife's extended family consisted of four brothers, their parents,wives and children all in the same house. They pooled their resources, no one went hungry, the bills got paid, all the children under school age were cared for.  School age children always looked neat, and clean with fresh school uniforms.  All school age children are taught English.  The children translated from Urdu to English and vice versa. My experience was mostly positive. I would go back if the opportunity presents itself. Even now we are no longer marrie.
